blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A 15-year-old boy stabbed and killed his 35-year-old uncle after a heated argument at past 8:30 p.m. on October 5, in Barangay Tapon, Dumanjug town in southwestern Cebu. According to initial investigation, the boy and his uncle were not on good terms for quite a while now, and last night they had a really heated argument, which ended with the uncle allegedly punching the boy.
